title: Complex Function Kaleidoscope
blurb: Domain coloring of a rational function: drag its zeros and poles and watch the phase colors, modulus contours and conformal checkerboard bend around them.
controls: Drag rings (zeros) and crosses (poles); click empty space to add a zero, right-click or Shift-click to add a pole, right-click or double-click a handle to remove it; scroll to zoom, drag to pan; presets, styles, phase spin, contour flow, z^k warp and f(f(z)) iteration in the panel; H hides UI, R records
